title: Inspect WirePlumber device properties
summary: Find the ID and properties of an audio device or node to use in configuration rules. This helps identify the correct name for matching rules.

steps.explain: List all devices and nodes managed by WirePlumber to find the ID of the target interface.
Inspect the specific object using its ID to view properties like node.name or device.name.

placeholders.name: OBJECT_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric ID of the device or node from wpctl status output.
